ticks.note: Power on: the first visit to `On` starts in `Home` (0).
Now `On` is itself the target of a history transition (from `Off`), so KIELER processes the history transitions inside it too: `Settings` resumes in `Contrast` (12).
Power on with `shallow history`: `On` resumes in `Settings`, but `Settings` starts again in `Brightness` (11). The fix changed what power-on does.
